consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.title: loss of containment at PSV-8201 during start-up after maintenance

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-8201 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. PSV-8201 (steam relief devices) is in service for boiler and deaerator overpressure protection. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 11 April 2007 an incident occurred on PSV-8201 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during start-up after maintenance, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
